source: G35 ANU Singapore 1958 survey sheet, native original MD5 verified by parent

method: Reviewed coast and tidal-bank source-pixel guides; blue ink classification B-R>8,G-R>0,R<180; source-nearest blue-pixel guide refinement <=35px; least-cost native raster paths in 35px guide corridors; exact repeated-pixel loops removed where printed tributaries have no resolvable second bank; 0.6px contour simplification.
